mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved by 6.8 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w, indicating a consistent upward trend. This momentum will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further above baseline as consumers continue to normalize shopping behavior.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -20.1 to -13.3 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -46.3% in t-0w, showing minimal recovery
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points over the next 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -40%.

This seasonal shift will redirect consumer foot traffic from outdoor recreation to indoor retail and recreation venues, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the last 28-day mean, or PARKS continues to deteriorate below -15%.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES at -19.1% in both t-1w and t-0w

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the prior 28-day mean, or GROCERY_PHARM reverts to negative territory.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days, or RESIDENTIAL increases above 6%.
